data.name: RF power meter
data.function: Diode or thermistor power head with its readout, used on the bench to set the absolute power leaving a generator or arriving at a fridge input before anything is connected to the qubit. It is the only instrument in the lab that measures power on an absolute scale rather than a ratio, so it is what anchors the attenuation budget: every dBm quoted for a drive line traces back to a head like this one. Calibration factor and frequency response are entered per head, and the reading is averaged over many RF cycles, so it reports average power, not the envelope.

physics.summary: Absolute average RF power; anchors the line attenuation budget (T07).

data.tooltip: RF power meter: absolute average power, the reference for the dBm budget.
